newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO JAN-AUG BENECOL SALES STEADY.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO JAN-AUG BENECOL SALES STEADY.

text.p: Finnish food, chemicals and animal feeds group Raision Tehaat Oy said on Tuesday sales of its Benecol cholesterol-reducing margarine remained roughly constant in January-August, but gave no details.
Preparations for export "or other internationalisation" for the margarine, so far only available in Finland, are going according to plan, Raisio said in a statement with its January-August results.
It said it would soon start installing machinery and equipment at the new plant sterol factory it is building, and trial runs of sub-processes would then begin immediately.

Raisio said it had launched cooperation with foreign researchers "at various universities and research institutions" to increase knowledge of the properties of the stanol esters contained in the margarine, made from plant sterol.

"The effect of legislation on the use of stanol esters in the EU member states and North America is being investigated," Raisio said. "Preparations are also being made for permit application processes."
Raisio said it had boosted staff in the unit for sterol acquisition and development, and resources for marketing and process and product development were also being strengthened.
